Title: September 2026 Board Briefing
ExecutiveSummary: Trading is ahead of plan with resilient services margin and improved renewal performance. Management requests approval for the Denver capacity expansion and the revised cyber insurance posture.

Sections.Heading: Commercial performance
Sections.Body: Enterprise bookings were led by public infrastructure and logistics. Pipeline coverage is 3.4 times the fourth-quarter target.

Sections.Heading: Operations
Sections.Body: Delivery utilization normalized to 78 percent while voluntary attrition declined. Quality indicators remain within appetite.

Sections.Heading: Risk outlook
Sections.Body: Vendor concentration and credential phishing remain principal risks. Mitigations are funded and tracked monthly.
